confidence_flags: position_measured_from_png_not_printed: carries the dashed B2 beam in the grid3-4 bay on S-04 (floor1). No printed offset dimension isolates it. Pixel scan of the PNG: beam faces at y=915 and y=930.5, centreline y=922.75; rows E and D measure y=761.5 and y=1052.75 = 3.70m apart, giving 78.7 px/m, so this line sits 2.05m below row E. The E-D bay midpoint would be 3.85, so it is NOT the midpoint

position_measured_from_png_not_printed: carries the B1 divider between the two upper S1 bathrooms in the grid2-3 bay on S-05 (floor2). Same pixel-scan method: beam faces y=938.5/953.5, centreline y=946, rows E and D at y=761/1052.5 — 2.35m below row E. It is a DIFFERENT line from E' (0.30m = 24px apart, far beyond the ±1-2px repeatability of the scan), not the same divider seen on both floors
